taskVersion.name: ves-heldout-item

parts.text:
You are a hydrogeologist preparing site notes for a borehole drilling team.

Station H-07 (survey area H). Interpreted VES layer model:

Layer | Resistivity (ohm-m) | Thickness (m) | Depth to base (m)
----- | ------------------- | ------------- | -----------------
1 | 1790.5 | 0.52 | 0.52
2 | 384.0 | 1.63 | 2.15
3 | 73.0 | 22.70 | 24.85
4 | 103.4 | 11.48 | 36.33
5 | 540.2 | 1.37 | 37.70
6 | 520.8 | - | -

Write the site note using exactly this template:

Station: <station name>
Curve type: <VES curve type>
Aquifer depth: <depth range in m>
Recommendation: <one or two sentences for the drilling team>

Station: H-07
Curve type: QHAK
Aquifer depth: 2.15 m – 24.85 m
Recommendation: Target the low-resistivity zone (73 Ω·m) between approximately 2.2 m and 24.9 m depth as the primary aquifer horizon; case off the shallow resistive overburden (0–2.15 m) and position screen intervals within the 2.15–24.85 m zone, confirming lithology at the base contact (~24.85 m) where resistivity rises into the underlying layer.
